output.answer_markdown: Management cites the quantity and diverse nature of its vendor agreements, which requires estimates of how much vendor funding to recognize in earnings versus defer as an offset to inventory [1]. These estimates depend on a detailed analysis of the classification of the funding type and the methodology for recognizing purchases-based funding in cost of sales, which considers inventory turn and actual sell-through [2]. The overall level of vendor funding deferral has remained relatively stable over the last three fiscal years [3], and a 10% change in it would have affected fiscal 2022 net earnings by approximately $35 million [4].
